address: Chantra Khiri Hotel, 49 Mu 3, Ban Pong, Hang Dong, Chiang Mai, 50230, Thailand
bio: Set up in the hills inside the Chantra Khiri Hotel, Na Chantra offers gorgeous views of the national park and a menu that features central and northern Thai dishes. Vegetables and herbs come from their next-door farm and everything else – like the savoury northern sausage with chilli paste – is made from scratch. Don’t miss their signature minced pork with fresh veg and spicy sauce, or the piquant yellow curry soup with sea bass. Start your evening outside, with a seat by the infinity pool....
